svg.title: Trust boundaries
svg.desc: What crosses into scrutate (repository content, patterns, MCP requests, a command line call to a running server) and what it writes (.scrutate), with the controls the security assessment names on the boundary each one guards. The network is not used.

g.text: THE BOUNDARY: THE CONTROLS ON IT
Parsed as data: nothing is evaluated, imported
or run. One exception: grep -z runs the
Symlinks are not followed by default; -L
Engine B skips binary files and files over 1
MB; the resolver does not read a file nested
follow = true in the repository's own
Rust regex: linear time, no backtracking,
size limits (20 MB regex, 10 MB DFA); an
A path that leaves the root by its own parts
is refused with nothing looked at.
Malformed input gets the JSON-RPC error the
specification names; at most 32 call threads
serve runs; no network port; the command line
Both ends check the peer is the same user
before a byte is read; a link or a file of
The command line does the work itself unless
the server is the same build, settings and
segments go to a temporary directory there and
A .scrutate that is a link, or holds one, is
validated; a damaged index is rebuilt.
Found from git's own files, no program run;
the link must be confirmed both ways.
Read only, in one snapshot; the same link
An artifact is used only for bytes that hash

No network connections and no HTTP or DNS
